newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eight Dubai cargoes offered in India crude tender.
newsitem.headline: Eight Dubai cargoes offered in India crude tender.

text.p: At least eight cargoes of Dubai crude oil have been offered into India's import tender for November loading, traders said on Friday.
The tender, which closed on Thursday, is expected to be awarded this weekend, traders said.
It sought a range of crude oils, including Far East, Middle East and West African grades.
Traders said the eight Dubai cargoes were offered on the basis of first-half November month quotes and at premiums ranging from 41 cents to 55 cents.
Traders said two cargoes of Egypt's Gulf of Suez crude were offered into the tender, one on an official selling price basis and one on a Dubai-related quote.
Market sources also said that around five or six very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Nigeria's Qua Iboe were offered by majors and traders. The offers were around dated Brent plus 95 cents to $1.08.
